out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT PERMIT NEEDS TO BE FACING THE PUBLIC FOR THEM TO SEE. PIC WILL MOVE PERMIT BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell eggs are being stored above ready to eat foods in the 3DR prep top unit.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY RAW FOODS CANNOT BE STORED ABOVE READY TO EAT FOOD AND MUST BE STORED BELOW IN ORDER TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. PIC MOVED THE RAW SHELL EGGS BELOW THE RTE FOODS IN THE COOLER.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT A ALL ITEMS TAKEN OUT OF THEIR ORIGINAL CONTAINER MUST HAVE A LAB ON THEM TO IDENTIFY WHAT THE CHEMICAL INSIDE IS. PIC BEGAN LABELING ALL CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Multiple food items were being stored on the floor in the walk-in refrigerator and the food prep line.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT FOOD IS NEVER ALLOWED TO BE STORED ON THE FLOOR AND MUST HAVE THIS ISSUE FIXED BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE REASONING FOR KEEPING SANITIZING TOWLES IN THE CHEMICAL SANITIZER WHEN NOT IN USE. PIC REMOVED THE WET TOWELS FROM FOOD PREP AREAS. SOPHIA'S DELI (Inspection Date: 07/11/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed clean single-use food service containers were stored in a manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination, next to a hand washing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL SINGLE USE FOOD SERVICE ITEMS MUST BE STORED IN AN AREA THAT WILL PROTECT IT FROM DIRT, DEBRIS, ETC. PIC MOVED THE SINGLE USE ITEMS BEING STORED TOA BETTER AND DRY LOCATION WHERE THEY WILL NOT BE CONTAMINATED.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of multiple food items in the dry stock area and in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS DISCUSSED THAT THE ONLY CONTAINERS THAT CAN BE USED TO STORE FOOD ITEMS ARE PICKELS AND SOY SAUCE CONTAINER. PIC WILL BEGIN REPLACING ALL SINGLE USE CONTAINERS BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.
